name: External Ratings
description: Server-side plugin that resolves the community score of an external source and writes it into Jellyfin's standard CommunityRating field - natively visible on all clients including TV apps, without any web-UI hacks. IMDb is served from a local copy of IMDb's own dataset files, with no API key and no request quota, and covers movies, series, seasons and episodes. MyAnimeList and eight other sources come through mdblist and need a free API key.
overview: Resolves external community ratings (IMDb, or MyAnimeList and eight more via mdblist) into Jellyfin's CommunityRating field.

versions.changelog:
Adds season and episode ratings, and an IMDb source that needs no API key.
- New IMDb source, resolved from local copies of IMDb's own dataset files (title.ratings, plus
  title.episode for season scores). No API key, no request quota, and it covers all four item
  levels. The files are downloaded on your server and refreshed on a schedule you pick
  (daily/weekly/monthly, or never).
- Seasons and episodes can now be rated. Both are off by default - turn them on under
  "Item levels". An episode is matched by its own IMDb id only, never by its position in the
  season, because TheTVDB and IMDb numbering diverge for some shows.
- A season score is IMDb's season: the mean over every episode IMDb lists for it, so it matches
  the figure IMDb's own page shows even when you only hold part of the season. Which IMDb season
  a season is comes from its episodes' ids; if they land in two IMDb seasons, or none, nothing is
  written rather than something guessed.
- The provider setting is gone. You choose only a rating source per library, and the plugin picks
  the way to resolve it from the source, the item level and the ids the item actually has.
- An item whose source cannot serve its level is cleared, not skipped, so the field always shows
  the configured source or nothing.

Fixes the realtime item listener deleting episode community ratings.
- The listener handed every changed item to the pipeline without the level filter the scheduled
  pass applies. An Episode therefore arrived as an unsupported level, where the default
  UnsupportedLevelBehavior=ClearField removed its rating - an item the full pass never touches.
  The realtime path now applies the same supported-level filter as the full pass.
- Docs: records that a metadata write wakes another plugin's item listener but does not cause
  media-segment re-analysis, and why 0 is not a portable no-rating sentinel.

First release. Resolves MyAnimeList community scores (via the mdblist API) into Jellyfin's native
CommunityRating for Movies and Series.
- Lookup by Tmdb/Imdb/Tvdb id with positive + negative caching, batch prefetch, a daily request
  budget, and a shared circuit breaker that pauses on repeated errors / HTTP 429.
- Triggers: on-demand scheduled task, automatic post-library-scan pass, and a realtime item listener
  that enriches items as they change (debounced, self-write-guarded, ignores manual edits).
- Writes via ItemUpdateType.MetadataEdit so per-library NFO savers stay consistent with the DB.
- Locked items (IsLocked) are never overwritten, so a manually set rating can be protected.
- Config page actions: run now, restore all original ratings, clear the rating cache.
Targets Jellyfin 10.11.x (net9.0).
